purpose: Define the common, versioned Health Summary that every daily derivation returns: the canonical header with its identity, processor and derivation versions, applied policy identities, primary state, evidence conditions, coverage, and Data Watermark; the evidence manifest that lists every Source Record the derivation attributed to the day with its standing; the total rule that chooses one primary state; the closed vocabularies of primary states, evidence standings, evidence conditions, and publication conditions; and their validation and RFC 8785 encoding, without deriving any value or having any persistence effect.

inputs.name: summary_key
inputs.description: One derived measure and record type pair from the set-source-selection-policy@1 measure vocabulary, and one local date.

inputs.name: versions
inputs.description: The derivation version of the concrete derive unit, in the form <scope>@<version>, and the processor version of the record type under which every attributed outcome was produced.

inputs.name: applied_policies
inputs.description: The identity of the Source Selection Policy applied to the day, or none, and the policy identity that interpret-source-projection@1 gave each attributed outcome, which names any Fallback Timezone Policies it used.

inputs.name: attributed_evidence
inputs.description: For every Source Record the derivation attributed to the day: its record, selection, and outcome identities, its standing (contributing, unresolved, in-conflict, policy-pending, failed, or quarantined), and the outcome's processor version and policy identity where one exists.

inputs.name: reported_conditions
inputs.description: The evidence conditions the derivation reports from the closed vocabulary, such as selection-unresolved or equal-time-conflict.

inputs.name: delivery_positions
inputs.description: For each Sender Installation whose accepted messages the derivation considered: the highest Sender sequence through which every archived message of that installation carrying the summary's record type was indexed and terminally processed, that message's Portal receipt time, and the processing completion time.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: The derive unit's type-specific values as RFC 8785 canonical JSON object bytes, or none when the derivation has no usable value.

outputs.name: health_summary
outputs.description: An immutable Health Summary: RFC 8785 canonical header bytes, canonical evidence manifest bytes, the body bytes or none, and the summary digest, which is the SHA-256 of the header bytes and so covers the manifest and body digests.

outputs.name: primary_state
outputs.description: Exactly one of measured, partial, missing, failed, quarantined, policy-pending, or unresolved, chosen from the coverage counts and whether a value exists by one total rule every derivation follows.

outputs.name: coverage
outputs.description: Counts of the Source Records attributed to the day by standing, relative to the retained, processed evidence at the Data Watermark; never a claim about the real world, wear time, or later evidence.

outputs.name: data_watermark
outputs.description: The per-installation delivery positions incorporated, with receipt and processing times, and the evidence-set digest; it never claims that the source has no later, missing, or unavailable evidence.

outputs.name: vocabularies
outputs.description: The closed, versioned sets of primary states, evidence standings, evidence conditions stored in a summary, and publication conditions that later units attach at read time but never store in a summary.

outputs.name: decoded_summary
outputs.description: A stored summary's header, evidence manifest, and body bytes checked and decoded back into the same Health Summary, or a named failure.

outputs.name: summary_failure
outputs.description: A named failure raised instead of a summary, carrying only its name: no value, date, Source Identity, origin, or bytes.

owns: the Health Summary header: its fields, their validation, and their RFC 8785 canonical bytes and digest
the evidence manifest: one entry per attributed Source Record with its standing, and the evidence-set digest
the closed primary-state vocabulary and the one total rule that chooses a primary state
the closed evidence-standing, evidence-condition, and publication-condition vocabularies, and how they grow by contract version
the meaning of coverage, and the rule that only measured and partial summaries carry a value
the Data Watermark's shape and what it may and may not claim
which header and failure content is free of health values, origins, and Source Identities
decoding stored summary bytes of every supported contract version
does_not_own: deriving any value, or deciding which evidence a record type attributes to a day, which origins overlap, or what is unresolved; the derive units do
the body's type-specific fields, units, or values
Duplicate Groups and equal-time ties; duplicate-observation-contract does
range periods, presets, and range counts; range-summary-contract does

storing, selecting, publishing, or activating summaries, Summary Refresh Jobs, Processor Generations, Cutover Targets, Candidate Builds, or Cutover Records; operational-store@6 and refresh-summary-state do
computing delivery positions or processing times from the store, or deciding when a publication condition applies
recording or activating Source Selection or Fallback Timezone Policies, and the measure vocabulary, which set-source-selection-policy@1 owns
how any state or condition is rendered
